title: tc-parallel-attempts
description:
Several attempts at one task, side by side like a race; the best finished one is marked and picked, and you can
pick another.

attempts.description: The attempts, one row each – name, approach, status and, once done, a score

task.description: What all of them try to do – e.g. "Fix the flaky checkout test"

picked.description: The id of the attempt in use; null or an unknown id falls back to the best finished attempt once all are through

approach.description: How this one goes about it, in a few words – e.g. "Mock the payment API"

model.description: The model behind it – shown after the name

progress.description: How far it is, 0 to 1 – the bar's length while it runs

step.description: What it does right now, while it runs – e.g. "Running tests 12/20"

score.description: 0–100 once done – the highest finished score is the best

note.description: One line about the outcome – e.g. "20/20 runs green" or the error

took.description: How long it took, in ms
